$comment: This file documents the vocabulary the deterministic renderer produces and gives
future regional profiles (FAA, localised) a shape to follow. The renderer's
behaviour lives in DeterministicPhraseology.cs; this is reference and validation data,
not a template the renderer interpolates.

examples.$comment: Canonical renderings. The domain unit tests assert against these exact strings.
examples.frequency119125: one one nine decimal one two five

clearanceTemplates.$comment: Descriptive only. Shows the element order the renderer uses.
clearanceTemplates.ifrClearance: {callsign}, cleared to {destination}, {route}, {runway}, climb initially {initialAltitude}, squawk {squawk}, departure frequency {frequency}.
clearanceTemplates.taxi: {callsign}, taxi holding point {runway} via {taxiRoute}, hold short {holdShortRunway}.

$comment: Phrases the phraseology validator treats as permission grants. Generated text
containing any of these must be backed by a matching approved fact in the decision,
or the output is discarded and deterministic phraseology is used instead.
